'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Ten people are killed and four more are wounded after a [[suicide bombing|suicide bomber]] detonates his device near makeshift kiosks in [[Mogadishu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-attack/ten-killed-in-suicide-bomb-attack-in-somali-capital-idUSKBN2BQ04X (Reuters)]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] [[militant]]s attack two [[Somali Armed Forces|military]] bases in [[Lower Shabelle]] with suicide [[car bomb]]ings and [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] shells. Nine Somali soldiers are killed and eleven others are injured. An army general says 76 militants are killed in retaliation, and ten captured. [https://www.voanews.com/africa/al-shabab-attacks-military-bases-southern-somalia (VOA)]
*[[Naxalite insurgency]]
**A gun battle between security forces and rebels in the [[India]]n state of [[Chhattisgarh]] results in the deaths of 22 [[Central Reserve Police Force|state paramilitary personnel]] and one [[Naxalite|militant]]. Thirty more soldiers are wounded. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/4/indian-forces-killed-gunbattle-with-maoist-rebels (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*The remains of 22 [[pharaoh]]s are transferred from [[Cairo]]'s [[Egyptian Museum]] to the [[National Museum of Egyptian Civilization]], which is set to fully open the following day, in a procession dubbed "The [[Pharaohs' Golden Parade]]". [https://www.ctvnews.ca/sci-tech/golden-parade-carries-pharaohs-to-new-home-in-egyptian-capital-1.5373422 (CTV News)]
*[[Pope Francis]] sends a video message to the [[Philippines]] to mark the 500-year anniversary of the first Mass on Philippine soil on [[Easter Sunday]]. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/pope-francis-sends-easter-message-to-philippines-to-mark-500th-anniversary-of-first-mass (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Hualien train derailment]]
**Prosecutors in [[Taiwan]] seek the arrest of a truck owner whose unattended vehicle rolled onto railway tracks, causing the accident that killed 50 people. [https://news.sky.com/story/taiwan-prosecutors-seek-arrest-of-truck-owner-in-crash-that-killed-50-12264488 (Sky News)]
*[[2021 Suez Canal obstruction]]
**The last of the 422 backlogged ships stranded by the grounding of MV ''Ever Given'' pass through the [[Suez Canal]], and normal operations resume. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/4/3/suez-canal-shipping-backlog-to-end-on-saturday (Al Jazeera)]
*A [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[Florida]] amidst mass evacuations owing to the potential collapse of toxic [[phosphogypsum]] waste reservoirs at the [[Piney Point phosphate plant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/florida-reservoir/imminent-reservoir-wall-collapse-threatens-polluted-flood-of-tampa-bay-idUSL1N2LX096 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Ontario]] enters a four-week "emergency brake" province-wide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] that was announced by [[Premier of Ontario|Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] on Thursday amidst a third wave of [[COVID-19]]. Indoor and outdoor dining, and indoor organized public events and social gatherings, are prohibited. There are also capacity restrictions for in-person shopping, as well as weddings, funerals, and religious services.  [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/covid-19-ontario-shutdown-hospital-intensive-care-icu-patients-1.5969831 (CBC)]
****[[Canada]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/canada-surpasses-1-million-confirmed-covid-19-cases-since-start-of-pandemic-1.5373550 (CTV News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
*****The [[United States]] records four million [[COVID-19 vaccine]] doses administered in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/04/03/health/us-coronavirus-saturday/index.html (CNN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Government of the Philippines|government]] extends the [[COVID-19 community quarantines in the Philippines#Enhanced community quarantine (ECQ)|enhanced community quarantine]] imposed on the [[Greater Manila Area]] until April 11, following the report of a record 15,310 new confirmed cases the previous day. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/philippines-covid-19-curbs-lockdown-manila-extended-14549662 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****The [[Government of Bangladesh|government]] announces a one-week nationwide lockdown beginning April 5 due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases and deaths. [[Factory]], utility, and [[emergency service]]s are exempt from the lockdown. [https://m.economictimes.com/news/international/world-news/bangladesh-to-impose-7-day-nationwide-lockdown-amidst-spike-in-covid-19-cases/articleshow/81885261.cms (The Economic Times)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[India]] reports 89,129 new cases in the past 24 hours, the highest daily total since September 20. The country also reports 714 deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily total since October 21. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-india-cases-idUKKBN2BQ06Z (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (country)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] receives 100,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine. However, vaccination will not begin until the country receives an approval from the [[World Health Organization]]. [https://agenda.ge/en/news/2021/891 (Agenda.ge)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] enters a three-day nationwide lockdown on the eve of [[Easter]] amidst a variant-fueled spike of COVID-19 cases. Non-essential shops are closed, restaurants and bars are only allowed to offer for takeout or delivery, and travel between [[Regions of Italy|region]]s and visits to the relatives are severely limited through Monday. [https://apnews.com/article/world-news-travel-italy-rome-coronavirus-pandemic-1adf3d6ff48ed02921a3f76073329c21 (AP)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] reports a record 44,756 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 3.44 million. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/largest-daily-spike-pushes-covid-19-cases-in-turkey-to-new-record/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 20,341 new confirmed cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1.73 million. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/covid-19-record-20341-new-cases-396-deaths-18814-vaccinations.html (''Kyiv Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 alleged Jordanian coup d'état attempt]]
**[[Jordan]]ian authorities arrest 20 people, including [[Hashemites|royal family]] member Hassan bin Zaid and former royal court head [[Bassem Awadallah]], for a plot to topple [[King of Jordan|King]] [[Abdullah II of Jordan|Abdullah II]]. Crown Prince [[Hussein, Crown Prince of Jordan|Hussein bin Abdullah]] is also told by security personnel to "cease any movement and activities that could be used to target the security and stability of Jordan". [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/04/03/middleeast/jordan-royal-family-arrested-hassan-bin-zaid-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/jordanian-royal-detained-for-plot-against-king-abdullah-report-664003 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[2021 Northern Ireland riots]]
**Three cars are hijacked and burned in [[Newtownabbey]] and rioters attack a police vehicle as disturbances enter their sixth day.<!--source indicates Friday was day 5--> Police announce seven people aged from 13 to 25 have been charged with [[riot]]. [https://www.irishexaminer.com/news/arid-40258163.html (''The Irish Examiner'')]
